datasets.name: Mexico City cumulative line-of-sight displacement
datasets.units: cm line-of-sight displacement relative to a reference point
datasets.license: Product-specific redistribution terms not recorded in the supplied export; verify with NASA ASF DAAC.
datasets.processing: Last product of each reference block chained by summation; atmosphere is not fully corrected; small reference drift between blocks is possible.
caveats: LOS displacement is not vertical displacement.
Negative values mean motion away from the satellite.
Atmospheric delay and reference-point effects may contribute.
